cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C5: the defining anionic is the alkyl-sulfate-type Sodium Coco-Sulfate@4 (C3, C4), buffered by two prominent buffers, Coco-Glucoside@2 (nonionic glucoside) and Sodium Cocoamphoacetate@5 (amphoteric), with no reinforcing strong anionic. Counter-signal: the glucoside is listed before the sulfate and glycerin@3 sits between them, so the sulfate is plausibly a secondary route; this argues for low and caps confidence at moderate (C-conventions keep the value). Formula-only property (Section 4).

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful conditioning system (cationic Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride@12, prominent) plus light routes (weak refatters Ascorbyl Palmitate@10, Glyceryl Oleate@11, Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate@13, Lecithin@14; humectants Glycerin@3, Panthenol@7). C2 not met: no silicone, no payload_lipid, no pearlizing/fatty route. Counter-signal: the guar sits after Panthenol/Niacinamide/Tocopherol, plausibly at a low level, so low is the realistic neighbor.

weightPotential.counterevidence: Two deposition families are present (cationic guar plus weak refatters); a real cationic guar can leave some residue through dilution deposition irrespective of position.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: The only depositing clues are a single cationic guar listed after the typical sub-1% actives (Panthenol@7, Niacinamide@8, Tocopherol@9) and light weak refatters; no silicone, no payload_lipid, no film former; a C5 sulfate chassis with two buffers gives moderate reset.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate (W2): the second family is weak_refatter only (Glyceryl Oleate@11, Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate@13, Lecithin@14, Ascorbyl Palmitate@10), and the single guar@12 is listed after the sub-1% actives, facing a moderate reset, so combined residue plausibly stays below noticeable.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: W2 boundary: two families present and guar level unknown; realistic unknowns could move it to moderate.
weightPotential.rationale: Low (6.6 anchors): light/low-persistence deposition (one late cationic guar plus weak refatters) against a moderate reset; W2 reason recorded; no W-RICH (no payload_lipid). W-line Panthenol@7 recorded per 6.8; it gates nothing here.
